steps.say: A fraction of a number means the fraction times the number, so multiply \([[of]]\) by \(\frac{[[in_num]]}{[[in_den]]}\).

The denominator divides the whole number here, so the answer is a whole number rather than a fraction: \([[out_num]]\). Sharing \([[of]]\) into \([[in_den]]\) equal parts and taking \([[in_num]]\) of them gives the same value.
